title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘therefore, has a heightened interest in driving ambitious climate action’
part_context: Stresses that 2025 was one of the hottest years ever recorded; stresses that each of the last 10 years has ranked among the top 10 hottest years on record; underlines that Europe is the fastest warming continent in the world and, <del>therefore, has a heightened interest in driving ambitious climate action</del>; warns of the severe consequences of the El Niño phenomenon, exacerbated by climate change, predicted to be exceptionally strong in 2026 and 2027, with increasingly severe humanitarian consequences, including for food security and water availability[[18]](#footnote-19);
